old_problem: The proprietary suite lacked a pinned artifact/wrapper/subtest manifest and an independently approved platform thermal, fan, PSU and power envelope; harness PASS alone was not safe acceptance.
disposition_reason: The purpose, method and harness oracle are explicit. ED-03 permits exact artifact and project sensor limits as runtime prerequisites, while ED-14 preserves the full 60-minute qualification and ED-15 forbids PASS without the signed envelope.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row373 all 18 XLSX columns and history2966.
Retained installation, full thermal qualification, GPU sensor check and every subtest.
No proprietary artifact was obtained and no load ran.

test_case.test_name: NVQual thermal qualification with synchronized platform telemetry
test_case.purpose: Run the complete approved NVQual thermal suite on the matching stack and prove every subtest plus every independent platform sensor remains within signed limits through load and cooldown.
required_package: Licensed NVQual version/provenance/checksum and GPU-driver-SDK compatibility
Pinned thermal wrapper/hash and subtest manifest
Workload drain, cooling/power capacity, OOB and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: After artifact, capacity, isolation and approval gates, execute the pinned full NVQual thermal qualification once for the source 60-minute allocation; capture every subtest and synchronized platform telemetry, enforce hard stops, then cool down and verify final health.
test_case.expected_result: Every mandatory NVQual subtest reports PASS, all required sensors remain inside signed thermal/power/fan/PSU/throttle/error limits with complete samples, and GPU/host/services recover healthy after cooldown.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Both harness results and independent platform envelope must pass; an NVQual aggregate PASS cannot override a sensor excursion, missing sample or shortened smoke run.
safety_gate: Verified cooling, redundant power and OOB capacity
Abort on thermal/power/fan/PSU/XID/AER anomaly and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Subtest manifest and full raw log
Time-aligned sensor/power/error series and stop record
test_case.recovery: On excursion, abort via supported control, maintain cooling/power/OOB, cool to the approved recovery band, restore original runtime state, verify all devices/services and do not rerun automatically.
